title.value: Contextual bandit optimization of super-resolution microscopy
title.justification: The title directly reflects the core subject of the paper, which is optimizing imaging parameters using a contextual bandit framework.
title.quote: Contextual bandit optimization of super-resolution microscopy

extractions.description: This paper discusses the online optimization of optical microscopy parameters using a contextual bandit framework. The focus is on super-resolution microscopy, particularly STED nanoscopy, where imaging parameters must be optimized to balance conflicting objectives. The paper explores leveraging contextual information about the sample to facilitate the selection of imaging parameters, comparing various approaches including Kernel-TS and neural network-based methods for better optimization outcomes.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing imaging parameters in the context of super-resolution microscopy rather than discussing climate change or its impacts.
climate_change_is_central.quote: The online optimization of optical microscopy parameters aims at learning the set of imaging parameters while the experiment unfolds.
